name: Himegoto-Ai ~Hameru Oyako no Kimochi Yosa~
original_name: 秘姫妃-愛 ～嵌める母娘の気持ち良さ～
source: The King Rockla leads his army to suppress the rising power of barbarians on the border of  Welgaria Kingdom. Meanwhile, his son, who has long desired his mother and sister's bodies, plots to make them his own while hiding in the court. His sister, after finishing her swordplay practice, touches herself while murmuring her engagement with her fiancé, while his mother satisfies herself with her experienced hands due to her husband's absence. The prince watches them lustfully, believing it to be a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to make them his own.
translation: 罗克拉国王率领军队镇压韦尔加利亚王国边境的蛮族势力。与此同时，他的儿子一直渴望得到母亲和妹妹的尸体，并躲在法庭上密谋将它们据为己有。妹妹练习完剑术后一边抚摸着自己，一边低声念叨着与未婚夫的订婚，而母亲则因丈夫不在而用自己熟练的双手满足自己。王子贪婪地看着他们，相信这是一个千载难逢的机会，可以将他们据为己有。
